title: Old RustCrypto versions remain only via Caliptra crates
description: digest 0.10, signature 2.2, p384 0.13, sha2 0.10, rand 0.8 and x509-cert 0.2 in Cargo.lock come only from caliptra-dpe (cfc9a71) and caliptra-sw. As of November 2026, upstream main is still on them. Revisit when Caliptra upgrades; don't fork.
